description: Reference lists transcribed from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (development/rules-sources/srd-5.2.1-en.pdf; printed page equals PDF page). Used only to check that the hero tables name things the SRD contains. It is not a rules implementation. Costs are copper pieces (100 per GP).

species.name: Dragonborn
traits: Size: Medium; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Draconic Ancestry: choose Black (Acid), Blue (Lightning), Brass (Fire), Bronze (Lightning), Copper (Acid), Gold (Fire), Green (Poison), Red (Fire), Silver (Cold), or White (Cold).

Breath Weapon: replace an attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line, 5 feet wide. Dexterity save DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus; 1d10 ancestry damage, half on success. Damage rises at levels 5, 11, and 17. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.
Damage Resistance: Resistance to the damage type of your ancestry.
Darkvision: 60 feet.
Draconic Flight: from level 5, Bonus Action spectral wings give a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes, until retracted or Incapacitated; once per Long Rest.

species.name: Dwarf
traits: Size: Medium; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Darkvision: 120 feet.
Dwarven Resilience: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.
Dwarven Toughness: +1 Hit Point maximum, and +1 again each level.
Stonecunning: Bonus Action gives 60-foot Tremorsense for 10 minutes while touching a stone surface. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

species.name: Elf
traits: Size: Medium; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet (Wood Elf: 35 feet)
Darkvision: 60 feet (Drow: 120 feet).

Elven Lineage: choose Drow (Dancing Lights; Faerie Fire at level 3; Darkness at 5), High Elf (Prestidigitation, change to another Wizard cantrip after a Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3; Misty Step at 5), or Wood Elf (Druidcraft; Longstrider at 3; Pass without Trace at 5). Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for these spells. Leveled spells can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or with appropriate slots.
Fey Ancestry: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.
Keen Senses: proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.
Trance: no sleep needed; magic cannot put you to sleep. A conscious 4-hour trance finishes a Long Rest.

species.name: Gnome
traits: Size: Small; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Darkvision: 60 feet.
Gnomish Cunning: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
Gnomish Lineage: choose Forest or Rock; choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
Forest Gnome: Minor Illusion; Speak with Animals always prepared, cast without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest or with appropriate slots.

Rock Gnome: Mending and Prestidigitation. Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) with one spell effect. A touch and Bonus Action activate it. Up to three devices; each lasts 8 hours or until dismantled with a Utilize action.

species.name: Goliath
traits: Size: Medium; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 35 feet

Giant Ancestry: choose one boon; Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest. Cloud: Bonus Action teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied visible space. Fire: add 1d10 Fire damage to a damaging attack-roll hit. Frost: add 1d6 Cold damage to such a hit and reduce Speed by 10 feet until your next turn. Hill: knock a Large or smaller target Prone on such a hit. Stone: Reaction reduces damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier. Storm: Reaction deals 1d8 Thunder damage to a creature within 60 feet that damaged you.
Large Form: from level 5, Bonus Action become Large if space permits; Advantage on Strength checks and +10 feet Speed for 10 minutes or until ended. Once per Long Rest.
Powerful Build: Advantage on checks to end Grappled; count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

species.name: Halfling
traits: Size: Small; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Brave: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: move through a creature at least one size larger, but cannot stop in its space.
Luck: when a D20 Test rolls 1, you can reroll and must use the new roll.
Naturally Stealthy: can Hide while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

species.name: Human
traits: Size: Small or Medium, chosen at creation; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Resourceful: gain Heroic Inspiration after each Long Rest.
Skillful: proficiency in one skill of your choice.
Versatile: one Origin feat of your choice; Skilled is recommended.

species.name: Orc
traits: Size: Medium; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Adrenaline Rush: Bonus Action Dash also gives Temporary Hit Points equal to Proficiency Bonus. Proficiency Bonus uses per Short or Long Rest.
Darkvision: 120 feet.
Relentless Endurance: when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, drop to 1 instead; once per Long Rest.

species.name: Tiefling
traits: Size: Small or Medium, chosen at creation; Creature Type: Humanoid
Speed: 30 feet
Darkvision: 60 feet.

Fiendish Legacy: choose Abyssal (Poison resistance and Poison Spray; Ray of Sickness at 3; Hold Person at 5), Chthonic (Necrotic resistance and Chill Touch; False Life at 3; Ray of Enfeeblement at 5), or Infernal (Fire resistance and Fire Bolt; Hellish Rebuke at 3; Darkness at 5). Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for these spells. Leveled spells can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, or with appropriate slots.
Otherworldly Presence: Thaumaturgy using the same spellcasting ability as Fiendish Legacy.
